newsitem.title: USA: AT&T files suits vs two long-distance firms.
newsitem.headline: AT&T files suits vs two long-distance firms.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Wednesday it filed lawsuits against two long distance firms, charging them with false and misleading advertising.
Filed in federal court in Trenton, N.J., the AT&T suit alleged VarTec Telecom Inc and Telco Communications Inc are using deceptive advertising claims about customers' potential savings.
VarTec offers a "dial around" service called DimeLine while Telco offers the Long Distance Wholesale Club service.
Dial-around companies encourage consumers to use a five-digit access code to "dial around" their existing long distance carrier when placing a long distance call, AT&T said.
